test_batch_unbatch_graphs: test the utils.batch and utils.unbatch functions to convert between list of GraphsTuple and single batched GraphsTuple
test_pad_unpad_graphs: test utils.pad_with_graphs and utils.unpad_with_graphs to add and remove padding nodes, edges, and graphs from a batched GraphsTuple
test_segment_operations: test utils.segment_sum, segment_mean, segment_variance, segment_normalize, segment_softmax, and segment_max for aggregating values by segment IDs
test_fully_connected_graph: test utils.get_fully_connected_graph to generate a fully connected GraphsTuple with configurable nodes, edges, and self-edges
test_dynamically_batch_graphs: test utils.dynamically_batch to dynamically batch an iterator of GraphsTuple with configurable n_node, n_edge, and n_graph limits
